answer: A rename is breaking in both directions: old readers find amount missing (null or error) and new readers get no old data under that name, and the registry blocks it unless the format supports aliases. Do not rename in one edit. Use expand-migrate-contract: v(n) adds total_amount alongside amount, with both written and equal; migrate every listed consumer to total_amount; backfill and upcast replayed or late history; then drop amount only after 30 days with no reads in query logs and audits. Until then, a compatibility view can keep old readers working.
